### Light the Way
Author: Lauren Green McAfee
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-september-12-2022.html
Passage: Psalm 119:105
Points:
- Daily busyness often crowds out intentional time for reading and reflecting on Scripture.
- Consistently engaging with God's Word refreshes the soul and brings direction for daily living.
- Scripture functions as a lamp because it points directly to Jesus Christ, the true Light.
- Even when circumstances seem dark, the light of Christ cannot be overcome.
- Maintaining a habit of seeking God in His Word leaves an enduring spiritual example for others.

### Where to Hide the Bible
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-december-23-2021.html
Passage: Psalm 119:11
Points:
- Growing biblical illiteracy across modern culture requires Christians to return to essential spiritual disciplines.
- Memorizing Scripture is one of the most powerful habits for spiritual stability and maturity.
- Hiding God's Word means treasuring and storing truth within oneself like valuable treasure.
- Memorized verses provide an immediate shield against moral temptation.
- Recalling stored promises from Scripture brings deep comfort and hope during seasons of distress.

### God's Revealed Will
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/gods-revealed-will
Passage: Psalm 119:105
Points:
- God's revealed will consists of the clear commands and precepts recorded throughout Scripture.
- Believers are called to structure their daily lives and moral conduct around these biblical precepts.
- The Bible provides guiding wisdom and principles for major decisions such as marriage and vocation.
- Within the moral boundaries established by God's Word, Christians have true freedom to choose among good options.

### The Hidden Word
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-august-24-2026.html
Passage: Psalm 119:11
Points:
- Rather than merely displaying or carrying a Bible, believers are called to internalize its teachings.
- Jesus defeated Satan's temptations in the wilderness by quoting Scripture stored in His heart.
- Having God's Word ready in mind provides a vital spiritual defense against sudden temptations.
- Storing biblical truth internally empowers Christians to clearly and quickly share the gospel with others.
